content.text:
The floor for House Blend 1 kg is **€13.85**. List price is €18.40 and unit cost is €9.37, so the floor works out to about 25% off list. The margin sheet says nobody should quote below the floor. Going under it needs sign-off from the finance manager.

That's still above the Huila floor of €19.75. If they're actually pushing on House Blend, it may be a new ask that hasn't been logged yet.
